sloka: तं क्षिप्रतरमाप्लुत्य परामृश्याङ्गदो बली।करेण तस्य तं खड्गं समाच्छिद्य ननाद च ।। ६.७६.९ ।।
transliteration: taṁ kṣiprataramāplutya parāmṛśyāṅgado balī।kareṇa tasya taṁ khaḍgaṁ samācchidya nanāda ca ।। 6.76.9 ।।

translations.english: Mighty Angada springing up at a higher speed grasped his (Sonitaksha) hand and irritated him with a sword making loud noise.
